questions.question: A body of mass 5 kg is traveling with a uniform velocity of 2 m/s. The net force acting on the body is:
questions.explanation: Since the velocity is uniform, acceleration is zero, and by F=ma, the net force must be zero.

hi.question: 5 किग्रा द्रव्यमान का एक पिंड 2 मी/से के एकसमान वेग से चल रहा है। पिंड पर कार्य करने वाला कुल बल है:
hi.explanation: चूंकि वेग एकसमान है, इसलिए त्वरण शून्य है, और F=ma द्वारा, कुल बल शून्य होना चाहिए।

questions.question: When a carpet is beaten with a stick, dust particles come out of it. This phenomenon is an example of:
questions.explanation: The carpet moves with the stick, but the dust particles tend to remain at rest due to inertia.

hi.question: जब एक कालीन को छड़ी से पीटा जाता है, तो उससे धूल के कण बाहर निकल आते हैं। यह घटना किसका उदाहरण है:

questions.question: A constant retarding force of 50 N is applied to a body of mass 20 kg moving initially with a speed of 15 m/s. How long does the body take to stop?
questions.explanation: Acceleration a = -F/m = -50/20 = -2.5 m/s^2. Using v = u + at: 0 = 15 - 2.5t => t = 6 s.

questions.question: A bullet of mass 0.04 kg moving with a speed of 90 m/s enters a heavy wooden block and is stopped after a distance of 60 cm. The average resistive force exerted by the block is:

questions.question: The static friction between two surfaces is:

options.A: Always equal to the applied force

questions.explanation: Static friction adjusts its value to match the applied force up to the limiting friction value.

questions.question: The ratio of the magnitude of impulse to the change in momentum is:
questions.explanation: By Impulse-Momentum theorem, Impulse is exactly equal to the change in momentum.

questions.question: A lift is falling freely under gravity. The apparent weight of a person of mass m in the lift is:
questions.explanation: In free fall, acceleration a = g, so R = m(g - g) = 0.

hi.question: एक लिफ्ट गुरुत्वाकर्षण के तहत स्वतंत्र रूप से गिर रही है। लिफ्ट में m द्रव्यमान के व्यक्ति का आभासी भार है:

questions.question: Which force is necessary to keep a body moving in a circular path with constant speed?
questions.explanation: Centripetal force acts towards the center and provides the necessary acceleration to change the direction of velocity.

questions.question: A cricketer pulls his hands backward while catching a ball to:

questions.explanation: By increasing the time of impact, the rate of change of momentum (force) is decreased.

questions.question: Which law of motion is used to explain the recoil of a gun?
questions.explanation: The gun exerts a forward force on the bullet, and the bullet exerts an equal and opposite force on the gun.

hi.question: बंदूक के पीछे हटने की व्याख्या करने के लिए गति के किस नियम का उपयोग किया जाता है?
hi.explanation: बंदूक गोली पर आगे की ओर बल लगाती है, और गोली बंदूक पर समान और विपरीत बल लगाती है।

questions.question: The maximum value of static friction is called:
questions.explanation: Limiting friction is the maximum friction force that must be overcome to start motion.

questions.question: The coefficient of kinetic friction is:

options.D: Independent of the nature of surfaces

questions.explanation: Once motion starts, the atomic bonds break and reform less easily, making kinetic friction lower than limiting static friction.
